title: Beyond the Box for Higher Education Act of 2026
latestAction: Read twice and referred to the Committee on Health, Education, Labor, and Pensions.
summary:
Beyond the Box for Higher Education Act of 2026

This bill requires the Department of Education to issue guidance and recommendations for institutions of higher education to remove criminal and juvenile justice questions from their admission applications.
